projects.name: The Plaza well
projects.purpose: Fresh water for the square, built ring by ring.

projects.name: The market hall
projects.purpose: A roofed hall where makers and farmers share what they have grown and made.

projects.name: Cottage 1
projects.purpose: A new home for the neighbours who are arriving; each cottage is built by the village together.

projects.name: The star observatory
projects.purpose: A raised stone platform where scholars chart the sky and record what they learn.

projects.name: The lantern path
projects.purpose: A lit path from the square to the fields so no one walks home in the dark.

projects.name: Cottage 2
projects.purpose: A new home for the neighbours who are arriving; each cottage is built by the village together.

projects.name: The field pavilion
projects.purpose: A shaded open pavilion beside the fields for rest, reading and shared meals.

projects.name: The library annex
projects.purpose: More shelves for the Harr Library, where every discovery is written down.

projects.name: Cottage 3
projects.purpose: A new home for the neighbours who are arriving; each cottage is built by the village together.

projects.name: The orchard fence and gate
projects.purpose: A low fence and a welcoming gate so the orchard can grow in peace.

projects.name: The research tower
projects.purpose: A slim glass-banded tower where scholars gather the village's findings into one view.

projects.name: The solar array
projects.purpose: Rows of solar glass that charge the village lamps by day and light the paths all night.

projects.name: The vertical farm
projects.purpose: A stacked greenhouse tower where crops grow in bright rooms, feeding more people from less land.

projects.name: The light fountain
projects.purpose: A basin of light and lamps where neighbours rest after a day of work.

projects.name: The sky transit hub
projects.purpose: A pale platform with a canopy and lamps, ready for the quiet light-rail and landing pads of the future.

projects.name: The open archive
projects.purpose: A long glass hall where every finding, plan and story is kept for anyone to read, and for other villages to learn from.

projects.name: The sky walk
projects.purpose: A raised promenade with lamps, so neighbours can cross the square and see the whole village.

projects.name: The glass garden
projects.purpose: A stepped glass dome over a garden of planters and benches, warm in every season.

projects.name: The Harr schoolhouse
projects.purpose: A two-storey house of study where young and old villagers learn reading, history and botany together.

projects.name: The seminar pavilion
projects.purpose: An open circular colonnade for philosophical discussion and research presentations.

projects.name: The makers' workshop hall
projects.purpose: A spacious open hall with visible forge-free craft benches for textile, wood, and ceramic artisans.

projects.name: The material recycling garden
projects.purpose: Tidy stone sorting bays where unused clay, timber trimmings and metal offcuts are sorted for reuse.

projects.purpose: A tiered open-air stone bowl facing the valley where residents gather for story circle.

projects.purpose: A stone and steel reservoir tower providing hydrostatic pressure to Harr's irrigation network.
